events.description: User successfully signs in (fires on Supabase SIGNED_IN auth state change on the sign-in page)
User completes sign-up (fires on Supabase SIGNED_IN auth state change on the sign-up page, covers OAuth sign-ups)
User submits the contact us form successfully
User clicks the CTA button on a pricing plan card
User submits the create profile form for the first time after sign-up
User is successfully signed out (fires before posthog.reset())
User saves changes to their profile (name, company, website)
User requests an email address change (confirmation emails sent to both addresses)
User changes their password via the change password form
User confirms account deletion by submitting the delete account form
